Garage description
Originally intended as a paint with active offensive properties, "Hive" was supposed to be enriched with special anti-tank bees. However, this plan was dropped due to numerous protests from animal-friendly organizations. As a result, the paint now only retains its color and texture.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on February 6, 2015.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Hive was worth 159,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Lieutenant General.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that protects incredibly well from enemy Vulcans, Ricochets and Freezes. Will make it much easier to survive combat at close and mid ranges. Covers your tank in a cute geometric pattern.
